name: dotnet-testing-filesystem-testing-abstractions

Use `System.IO.Abstractions` to make file/directory operations testable: inject `IFileSystem`, register `services.AddSingleton<IFileSystem, FileSystem>();` and `services.AddScoped<ConfigService>();`; use a fresh `MockFileSystem` per unit test, never the real file system. Use `_fileSystem.Path.Combine`, check existence, create necessary directories, and handle `UnauthorizedAccessException`, `IOException`, and `DirectoryNotFoundException`. Use `NSubstitute` to simulate exceptions unsupported by `MockFileSystem`.

Packages: `System.IO.Abstractions` and `System.IO.Abstractions.TestingHelpers` Version `21.*`.

Only create files necessary for testing
Avoid simulating oversized files in tests

See `templates/configmanager-service.cs` and `templates/filemanager-service.cs` for examples. Related skills: `nsubstitute-mocking`, `unit-test-fundamenta
